nodes.label: Face Recognition
nodes.rationale: Runs on the detect-role stream, not recordings, because recording latency would leave notifications without names, embedding models rescale to a fixed input anyway, and motion clarity matters more than extra pixels.

nodes.label: Small and Large Face Embedding Models
nodes.rationale: small runs a FaceNet embedding on CPU for efficiency; large runs ArcFace for accuracy and needs an integrated or discrete GPU/NPU. A landmark model aligns faces first in both cases, and a CPU with AVX + AVX2 is required.

nodes.label: Area-Weighted Multi-Frame Recognition
nodes.source_location: How Frigate Decides Who a Person Is
nodes.rationale: The sub_label comes from all recognition attempts while a person is in view, weighted by face area, so a single very high confidence match cannot assign a label and a few wrong guesses on blurry frames do not change the result.

nodes.label: Face Training Set Construction
nodes.rationale: Diversity matters more than volume: training already-high-scoring, blurry, grayscale/IR or near-duplicate images causes over-fitting and makes unknown people score like known ones. Bulk upload and negative training are deliberately unsupported, and bulk reprocessing is not offered because reprocessing only affects images at a similar angle.
